name: SuperMix 5

materials.cable: Litz high-purity silver-plated OCC with modular plugs

cons: Bone conduction effect is subtle for some listeners
Price is higher than many competitors
insight: SuperMix 5 is Simgot’s ambitious five-driver hybrid that adds a coil-type bone conduction driver to a DD + BA + micro-planar foundation. Reviewers note improved texture, stage openness, and a more natural sense of body in the mid-bass region. It represents one of the more innovative configurations in its price range.
